title: spatial-anno-metrics: cell-type annotation quality metrics for spatial and single-cell data
description: A small Python package for asking whether a cell-type annotation is any good, organised by the evidence available: reference-free internal validity and inter-sample consistency, marker-program fidelity and marker co-expression purity, reference-based purity, spatial label coherence, per-cell confidence and conformal prediction sets, annotation-independent signal QC, and external scores for benchmarks with a ground truth. Each metric is attributed to its source.
